points.description: States both core functions of a queue: enqueue (add an element to the rear/back) and dequeue (remove an element from the front).
points.partial_credit: Half (2 marks) if only one of enqueue or dequeue is named correctly, or both are named vaguely/with a minor error (e.g. 'add' and 'remove' without the terms).

points.description: Uses the correct terms 'enqueue' and 'dequeue' (or clear equivalents such as insert/add at rear and remove/delete from front) for the two operations.
points.partial_credit: Half (0.5) if only one term is given correctly.

rubric.notes: Full marks for naming both enqueue and dequeue in any wording or order; extra correct detail (rear/front, FIFO) is fine. Part marks if only one function is correct or the operations are described without the names. Give no marks for naming other operations (e.g. push/pop, peek, isEmpty) as the two main functions.
